title: Selection Bias Correction in Retail Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2608.26156v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retail intelligence often relies on monitoring popular, high-velocity products, potentially biasing economic indicators by ignoring the "long tail" of niche items. This simulation study investigates selection bias in inflation estimation and compares correction methods across diverse data-generating processes. Through 400 Monte Carlo replications spanning four scenarios--aligned step functions, smooth gradients, misaligned breaks, and polynomial relationships--we test the robustness of Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) with five specifications against stratification with varying strata counts. Our findings reveal fundamental limits of weighting methods in retail long-tail contexts: stratification achieves superior performance in three of four scenarios, maintaining sub-0.04pp median error even when boundaries deliberately misalign with population breaks (116x advantage over IPW). translated_title: 零售智能中的选择偏差校正
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26156v1 公告类型：新 摘要：零售智能通常依赖于监测流行、高流速产品，这可能通过忽略小众商品的“长尾”而使经济指标产生偏差。本模拟研究探讨了通货膨胀估计中的选择偏差，并比较了在不同数据生成过程下的校正方法。通过400次蒙特卡洛重复实验，涵盖四种场景——对齐阶跃函数、平滑梯度、错位断点以及多项式关系——我们测试了带有五种规格的逆概率加权（IPW）方法与不同层数的分层法的稳健性。我们的发现揭示了加权方法在零售长尾情境中的根本局限性：分层法在四种场景中的三种表现更优，即使在边界与总体断点故意错位时，也能保持中位误差低于0.04个百分点（比IPW优势达116倍）。然而，在平滑场景下，使用样条倾向模型的IPW表现更佳。
tldr: 该研究通过模拟实验证明，在零售长尾数据中，分层法在多数场景下优于逆概率加权方法，能有效校正选择偏差。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through simulations that stratification outperforms inverse probability weighting in most retail long-tail scenarios for correcting selection bias.
